data.title: MMA.INC Activates BJJLink at UFC GYM’s First Standalone Jiu-Jitsu Studio
data.description:
An update from Mixed Martial Arts Group ( (MMA) ) is now available.

Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited announced on September 15, 2026, that its BJJLink management platform has been deployed at UFC GYM’s first standalone jiu-jitsu studio in New York, which opened on August 8, 2026, with a Florida academy scheduled to follow. Under a multi-year agreement, BJJLink now runs core operations for this new studio format, handling memberships, billing, payments, scheduling, attendance, customer engagement and belt progression.

The launch shifts the UFC GYM partnership from planning into live operations, creating new recurring software and transaction revenue streams for MMA.INC without the need to own or operate physical gyms. Management presents the rollout as validation of BJJLink’s ability to standardize systems across multi-location networks in a fragmented U.S. martial arts studio market that IBISWorld estimates at 46,600 businesses and US$19.4 billion in annual revenue.

data.title: Quality Industrial Simplifies Capital Structure, Withdraws Series A
data.description:
Quality Industrial ( (QIND) ) has shared an update.

On September 11, 2026, Quality Industrial Corp. withdrew its Certificate of Designation for Series A Preferred Stock, originally established on April 4, 2018, after confirming that no Series A shares were outstanding. The board‑authorized move removes Series A as a designated class in the charter and returns those shares to authorized but undesignated preferred stock, simplifying the capital structure and preserving flexibility for future equity designations.

The withdrawal means all prior charter references to Series A Preferred Stock are now without legal effect, closing out a series that had never been issued. This adjustment has no direct dilution impact on existing shareholders but refines the company’s governance framework and may streamline future financing or restructuring decisions that involve preferred equity classes.

The move builds on its Florida footprint and aligns with its strategy to serve healthcare professionals in the Southeast as they adopt stem cell and regenerative medicine therapies under evolving state-level rules.

The deal brings pioneering luxury Antarctic interior journeys and vintage aircraft-based adventure itineraries into Lindblad’s portfolio, while White Desert and Echo Charlie will continue operating as stand-alone, founder-led brands, and Patrick Woodhead will assume leadership roles and advise Lindblad on strategic innovation.

data.title: Vivesto’s Paccal Vet Shows Survival Benefit in Canine Hemangiosarcoma Study
data.description:
Vivesto AB ( (SE:VIVE) ) has issued an announcement.

Vivesto AB has reported positive topline results from an open-label pilot study of its veterinary cancer drug candidate Paccal Vet in dogs with Stage I-II splenic hemangiosarcoma following splenectomy. The median overall survival of 135 days exceeded surgically treated historical controls, reinforcing the efficacy signal seen in interim data and supporting progression to a pivotal registration study.

Safety in the 26-dog cohort was considered tolerable with proactive monitoring, with most side effects typical of chemotherapy and manageable, though a small number of serious adverse events occurred at higher doses. The confirmation of benefit strengthens Vivesto’s partnering prospects with Liberi Group and may pave the way toward conditional approval and earlier market entry for Paccal Vet in a canine cancer indication that currently lacks any regulatory-approved therapies.
